name: proto-deterministic
note: KEPT, with this dated caveat (2026-08-08). ANY NUMBER OR VERDICT RECORDED FOR THIS ENTRY BEFORE COMMIT c77cbe98 IS VOID. Until then WorldInfo.coordinateSystem never reached the Newton solver: for a NUE world the gravity vector projected onto the builder's up_vector to exactly zero (nothing fell) and the implicit ground plane took its normal from the same axis, standing up as a vertical WALL -- and in this world that wall sits exactly where its four DistanceSensors are, so all four read 0.000000. The engine source names this world as the case. A Newton-era timing or PASS for it therefore measured a FROZEN SCENE. RE-VERIFIED after the fix, machine 9722d23d12a3, 2026-08-08: 20 s headless run, sidecar {backend: newton, solver: MuJoCo (cpu/mj_step, default), degraded: false}, and the world's own template_deterministic controller exited 0 -- i.e. all three of its DistanceSensor assertions passed (det1 == det2, nondet1 != nondet2, det1 != nondet2), which is only possible if the sensors read distinct non-zero values. KEPT rather than removed because it is this manifest's only NUE world and its only world-load entry, so deleting it would delete the manifest's only coverage of the coordinate-system plumbing that had just been silently wrong for 210 NUE worlds.
